controls.name: Start / Quick 30
controls.functionDescription: Starts microwave cooking or adds 30 seconds at high power.
controls.audioCueText: Start and Quick thirty seconds button. Located at the bottom right.
controls.tactileFeature: Smooth round tactile button with raised center pip
controls.safetyWarning: Starts immediate heating when door is securely latched.

controls.name: Stop / Reset
controls.functionDescription: Cancels current operation or resets cooking time to zero.
controls.audioCueText: Stop and Reset button. Located at the bottom left.
controls.tactileFeature: Smooth round tactile button with indented center

controls.name: Power Level
controls.functionDescription: Cycles through microwave power levels from 10 percent to 100 percent.
controls.audioCueText: Power level button. Second row, left side.

controls.name: Inverter Turbo Defrost
controls.audioCueText: Turbo defrost button. Second row, right side.
controls.safetyWarning: Requires setting food weight before starting.
